question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

Indifferent to pleasure and pain
solution:
The correct answer is '**Stoic**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate word for the given group of words is '**Stoic**'.
 
• It means 'suffering pain or difficulty without complaining'. (दुख के प्रति उदासीन; विरक्त)
 
 
• *Example: His personality is **stoic** to the point of being cold, even towards his younger brothers.*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *Stoic.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the meaning of other words:
 
 
• **Lusty**: healthy and strong; full of vigour. (स्वस्थ और मजबूत; जोश से भरा हुआ)
 
• **Prudent**: sensible and careful when making judgements and decisions; avoiding unnecessary risks. (मूल्‍यांकन और निर्णय करने में सावधान और विवेकपूर्ण; अनावश्‍यक ख़तरों से बचते हुए)
 
• **Cynic**: a person who believes that people only do things for themselves, rather than to help others. (व्‍यक्ति जो सबको स्‍वार्थी समझता हो; दोषदर्शी)
